WITH customer_2013_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_2013_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.Segment,
        SUM(cc.total_consumption) / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_2013_consumption cc
    INNER JOIN min_per_segment mps 
        ON cc.Segment = mps.Segment 
        AND cc.total_consumption = mps.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
